name: Sajek Valley
summary: A hilltop valley above the clouds with cottages, sunrise views and tribal villages. Popular for a one-night escape.
season_note: Winter mornings are clear and cold with cloud seas. Monsoon is green but wet.
avoid_note: Travel is by army-escorted convoy times from Khagrachhari or Dighinala. Check the current schedule and permission.

reach.how: Bus Dhaka to Khagrachhari, then a hired Chander Gari to Sajek on the allowed convoy time
reach.note: Plan to arrive at least a day ahead for the early convoy.

local.note: Fixed convoy times. Booking through your hotel helps.

attractions.name: Konglak Para
attractions.what: A Pangkhua community village and the high viewpoint of Sajek.

attractions.name: Ruilui Para and Helipad
attractions.what: A large flat viewpoint known for cloud views.

attractions.name: Sajek sunset point
attractions.what: Watch clouds roll over the valley.

attractions.name: Tribal villages (Lushai, Pangkhua)
attractions.what: Walk through villages and see bamboo houses and local weaving.

attractions.name: Kacahalong Waterfall
attractions.what: A quiet waterfall requiring a local guide and a walk.

rules: Follow the convoy timings and local rules.
Be quiet and respectful in villages.
